subject: Bangla
description: The Bangla LDG covers mother-tongue literacy: alphabet recognition, joined-letter reading, and comprehension. Gaps here often affect performance in all other subjects.

competencies.label: Letter Recognition (বর্ণ পরিচিতি)
competencies.description: Recognizing and naming all Bangla vowels (স্বরবর্ণ) and consonants (ব্যঞ্জনবর্ণ).

misconceptions.observed: Confuses similar-looking letters: ঘ/ণ, থ/য, প/ষ.
misconceptions.rootGap: Has not developed fine discrimination between visually similar Bangla graphemes.
misconceptions.evidence: Consistently misidentifies letters that share visual features.
misconceptions.strategy: Multi-sensory letter tracing; sort similar letters into groups; highlight distinguishing features.

competencies.label: Kar / Vowel Diacritics (কার চিহ্ন)
competencies.description: Reading and writing vowel signs (আ-কার, ই-কার, etc.) attached to consonants.

misconceptions.observed: Reads consonant only, ignoring the kar; reads কি as ক.
misconceptions.rootGap: Treats the base consonant as the full syllable; does not process the diacritic.
misconceptions.evidence: Skips or misreads vowel marks consistently.
misconceptions.strategy: Colour-code the kar; isolate consonant+kar pairs; flashcard drills with kar variation.

competencies.label: Joint Letters (যুক্তাক্ষর)
competencies.description: Reading and writing consonant clusters formed by joining two or more consonants.

misconceptions.observed: Stops completely at a juktakkhor; guesses or skips the word.
misconceptions.rootGap: Cannot decompose a joint letter into its constituent consonants.
misconceptions.evidence: Fluent until encountering a joint letter, then breaks down or guesses.
misconceptions.strategy: Teach joint-letter families (e.g., all ক্ষ clusters); break juktakkhor into parts; joint-letter chart on desk.

competencies.label: Bangla Reading Fluency
competencies.description: Reading Bangla text with speed, accuracy, and comprehension.

misconceptions.observed: Reads Bangla haltingly; decodes every syllable individually.
misconceptions.rootGap: Has not automatized Bangla decoding; all cognitive effort goes to letter/kar processing.
misconceptions.evidence: Cannot retell what was just read; reading speed far below oral language speed.
misconceptions.strategy: Repeated reading of familiar texts; paired reading with a fluent peer; read-aloud modeling.

competencies.label: Bangla Comprehension
competencies.description: Understanding and responding to Bangla text at literal and inferential levels.

misconceptions.observed: Reads a Bangla passage but cannot answer questions about it.
misconceptions.rootGap: Decoding effort consumes all attention; no capacity left for meaning-making.
misconceptions.evidence: Answers unrelated or says 'I don't know' even for literal questions.
misconceptions.strategy: Build fluency first, then layer comprehension; oral retelling in Bangla; prediction before reading.

competencies.label: Bangla Composition
competencies.description: Writing sentences and short compositions in Bangla with correct spelling and grammar.

misconceptions.observed: Spells words as they sound in dialect, not as they are written.
misconceptions.rootGap: Has not internalized standard Bangla spelling conventions.
misconceptions.evidence: Writes phonetically from spoken dialect; spellings match pronunciation but not standard orthography.
misconceptions.strategy: Word walls of high-frequency words; compare spoken vs written forms; dictation practice.
